item.tib: gsang chen seng ge sgra sgrogs las sgral (bsgral) las dam nyams brlag pa'i byi gri
item.coloph: kho bo hUM chen 'gro 'dul gling pas rgya gar bsil ba tshal nas dngos grub brnyes zhing*/ slar lo bdun gyi bka' rgya yol tshe/ don gnyer can 'ga' yis bskul ngor / shar rdza'i gdan sa gnyis par yig lam du phab pa dge des log byed rtsad nas bcad pa'i rgyu 'gyur bar gyur cig phyi mo'i yi ge po ni so bla rnam rgyal tshul khrims gyis byas pa dge legs 'phel lo//
